values.note: The city's posted rules: 'a fee of $15.00 per night, payable in advance at the Wastewater Treatment Plant.' The rules are dated 2007 but are the ones on the city's RV Park page now (file posted November 2025).

fees.source: https://www.cityofwabash.com/egov/apps/document/center.egov?view=item&id=191 ('Campers shall pay a fee of $15.00 per night, payable in advance at the Wastewater Treatment Plant.'), read 2026-10-31

values.note: Check in at the Wastewater Treatment Plant, 851 S Carroll, by 4 PM; check-out 12 PM. Stays over 14 days in 30 need a written contract with the Board of Public Works and Safety.

booking.source: https://www.cityofwabash.com/egov/apps/document/center.egov?view=item&id=191 ('Check-in must be done by 4:00 PM, and Check-out time is 12:00 PM'; 'Campers may not stay more than 14 days within 30 days, except by written contract'), read 2026-10-31

hookups.source: Google Maps reviews of Wabash City RV Park, read 2026-10-31 (camper reports; the city's pages don't list hookups): 'Great water pressure, 50 amp service. No sewage' (6 years ago); 'Water and electric sites... 50 & 20 amp only' (8 years ago)

note: City of Wabash, by the Wabash River 2 blocks from downtown; pay and collect the hookup keys at the Wastewater Treatment Plant next door. --Claude
summary: $15 confirmed from the city's posted rules, 14-in-30 limit added; hookups rest on camper reports (electric 50, water, no sewer); stored reservable and some_sites cleared since no city page mentions reservations. Phone 260-563-2941 and page confirmed. Pin 60 m off the pads, fine. Not waterfront stands.
flags: RATE DATE: the only city statement of the $15 is rules 'DATED THIS 17 DAY OF OCTOBER 2007', though they are what the city's RV Park page links today (file name stamped November 2025). Stored note's '$15-16'; inclusion_evidence's $16 was Campendium. A Google review 3 weeks ago says only 'Cheap spot.'

BOOKING: no city page mentions reservations. Stored 'first-come + reservations' came from note prose. An 8-year-old Google review: 'Reservations - you must go to the water treatment plant between 8 am and 4:30 pm to pay for a spot and get a set of keys. Sites - taken on a first come first serve basis upon arrival.' Cleared reservable and fcfs rather than guess.

WATER: on imagery the pads (angled paved spurs off a loop, visible, centred about 40.7910,-85.8243, 60 m from the stored pin, no move needed) sit north of a road and a line of trees, the Wabash River about 60-80 m south of the southernmost pads. Road and tree belt between: not waterfront stands, no view lead. The city's wastewater plant's clarifiers are directly across Carroll St to the west, 100-200 m away (imagery); a recent review adds 'loud cars and trains'. Google 4.5 from 11 reviews.

SITE COUNT unverified: note said ~18-24, inclusion_evidence 15, no city page gives one; a review says 'one electric hook ups for two sites'. Reviews call the pads 'non-level asphalt'. No length posted; imagery shows spurs long enough for a 23-ft rig. Dropped the count from the note.
